Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.
In this case:

```dafny
method ElementWiseSubtract(seqA: seq<int>, seqB: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)
    requires seqA != null
    requires seqB != null
    requires |seqA| == |seqB|
    ensures result != null
    ensures |result| == |seqA|
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> result[i] == seqA[i] - seqB[i]
{
    result := [];
    var i := 0;
    while i < |seqA|
        invariant 0 <= i <= |seqA|
        invariant |result| == i
        invariant forall j :: 0 <= j < i ==> result[j] == seqA[j] - seqB[j]
    {
        result := result + [seqA[i] - seqB[i]];
        i := i + 1;
    }
}
```
